verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs clearly claim automatic activation ('Claude uses skills when relevant', 'loads the skill by reading its full SKILL.md into context') and provide explicit guidance on engineering the description field for triggering accuracy, plus a skill-creator tool to 'optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy'. However, concrete hands-on evidence contradicts reliable auto-triggering: Vercel's eval found the skill was never invoked in 56% of cases despite being relevant, and multiple community reports describe triggering as 'hit or miss' even with proper YAML/semantic triggers, requiring explicit user prompts to invoke skills. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks showing consistently high automatic-trigger accuracy, and resolution of the documented invocation-failure rate.
